status: Retrospective diagnostic, manually reviewed with caveats; not untouched holdout, not evidence of calibration or betting edge

p50.note: Fixed bins [0,.1),[.1,.3),[.3,1]. Wilson95 is a marginal binomial diagnostic; player rows within matches are dependent. Match-cluster bootstrap95 resamples whole match ids500 times; it does not capture series dependence. No normality assumption for runs. Log-loss clipped at1e-12 only for numerical reporting.

definitions.conditional_bat_rates: Predicted aggregate rate=sum(event probability)/sum(Pbat); observed=sum(event)/number actually batted. DNB is excluded from the conditional denominator and never entered as run zero.
definitions.score_diagnostics: MAE, CRPS and inclusive central10th/90th percentile coverage apply to observed batters, using simulation scores conditional on batting; discrete intervals need not attain exactly80%.
definitions.medians: observed_median_runs is median actual runs among observed batters. predicted_median_runs is the median of their individual conditional predictive medians; it is not the median of a pooled predictive mixture.
definitions.roles: Expected role uses median of last5 strictly earlier observed positions with fallback6, then lexical names. Realised roles are diagnostic slices only; never forecast inputs.
definitions.p50_calibration: Unconditional event: scored50+ in the team innings; DNB outcome false, distinct from batted zero.
definitions.p_top_calibration: Binary membership of tied top set; not normalized. q Brier separately uses fractional1/k target.
definitions.target_eligibility: Same eligible flag as engine/evaluation; India/NZ records with11 listed players and dates>=2023; chronological final40 by default. Historical recorded roster is an oracle assumption.

limitations: No recalibration, model selection or changes fitted on retrospective outcomes.
Previously explored retrospective data; cannot certify calibration from this bounded dependent sample.
Calibration intervals resample match clusters; series dependence and hyperparameter selection uncertainty remain unmodeled. Small bins and realised-role slices are descriptive.
Intervals are predictive runs conditional on batting, not posterior uncertainty intervals for mean ability.
Forecast simulation integrates categorical PMFs; DNB and a genuine batted zero remain distinct.
